project: Sprint 21-A: DB Cleanup + Learning Table Migration
description: Fix 0-byte engine/jarvis_trader.db ghost file, create learning_events and trading_patterns migration, wire learning consolidator to EOD scheduler. P0-3 blocker resolution.

userStories.title: Delete ghost 0-byte jarvis_trader.db and prevent recreation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the engine to use only engine/data/jarvis_trader.db so that there's one canonical source of truth for all trade data.
acceptanceCriteria: config.py SQLITE_DB_PATH resolves correctly relative to engine/ working dir
python3 -c 'from engine.config import TradingConfig; c=TradingConfig(); print(c.SQLITE_DB_PATH)' prints 'data/jarvis_trader.db'
No new 0-byte DB created after import
userStories.notes: Ghost file is at engine/jarvis_trader.db (0 bytes). Real DB is at engine/data/jarvis_trader.db (18 tables, 2 paper trades). DB manager already defaults to data/jarvis_trader.db. COMPLETED: ghost file deleted, config verified.

userStories.title: Add learning_events and trading_patterns migration (migration_013)
userStories.description: As a system, I want learning_events and trading_patterns tables so that the learning loop can store and retrieve trading patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/database/migrations.py has migration_013 creating learning_events table
engine/database/migrations.py has migration_013 creating trading_patterns table
learning_events columns: id, trade_id, event_type, symbol, regime_tier, signal_strength, outcome, pnl_usd, created_at
trading_patterns columns: id, pattern_hash, symbol, regime_tier, conditions, win_rate, sample_count, last_seen, created_at
Migration runs without error on engine/data/jarvis_trader.db
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: migration_013 already exists with both tables. Tables have IF NOT EXISTS and proper indexes for symbol, regime_tier, and timing columns.

userStories.title: Wire TradingMemoryConsolidator into EOD scheduler
userStories.description: As a trader, I want the learning consolidator to run every evening at 4:05pm ET so that the system learns from each day's trades automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/main.py eod_summary_job calls consolidator.consolidate_daily() after P&L logging
Consolidator logs 'Memory consolidation starting' on invocation
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: Added consolidator call in eod_summary_job with non-fatal try/except. Added POST /learning/consolidate endpoint to learning_router.py. Router already registered.
